title: Monotonicity of a base-2 logarithm in a scale factor
statement:
Let $s \ge 1$ be a positive integer and let $\varepsilon > 0$ be a real number. Then
\[
\log_2\!\left(\frac{2}{\varepsilon}\right) \le \log_2\!\left(\frac{2s}{\varepsilon}\right).
\]
hypotheses_covered: s is a positive integer (0 < s)
ε is a positive real (0 < ε)
replaced:
For $s \in \bbn$ with $0 < s$ and $\varepsilon \in \bbr$ with $0 < \varepsilon$,
we have $\log_2(2/\varepsilon) \le \log_2(2s/\varepsilon)$.
